Client: get a Stripe Checkout link to pay for one pending milestone (its naira amount + fee).

Nothing is recorded as paid until Stripe confirms by webhook. Send an `Idempotency-Key`:
a retry with the same key returns the same checkout link (also passed on to Stripe).

get.description: The project's client or ops: funding, releases and payouts, newest first (`?cursor=&limit=`).

post.description: Client: dispute a verified milestone. It becomes `disputed`; nothing is released until resolved.

Ops: resolve a dispute. Needs two different ops users choosing the same outcome; the first
call records a proposal (`resolved: false`), the second resolves it.
A 15-minute pre-signed URL to PUT one photo (JPEG, max 10 MB) or video (MP4, max 60 MB).
Save a capture's metadata and signature once the file is uploaded; checks run in the background.

get.description: The project's photos and videos with 15-minute view links. Clients see accepted ones, EXIF-free.

post.description: Ops: accept or reject evidence the server flagged. Rejecting needs notes.

Contractor: the work for this milestone is done. The supervisor verifies it next.

Send an `Idempotency-Key` header: a retry with the same key returns the first answer.

Assigned supervisor: verify a claimed milestone with a checklist, or reject it with a reason.

`verified` moves it to `verified` (the client approves next); `rejected` sends it back to
`funded` so the contractor can rework and claim again. Every photo in the checklist must be
accepted supervisor evidence for this milestone. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header: the
offline sync queue retries with the same key and gets the first answer back.

Client: approve a verified milestone. Escrow is asked to release its money to the contractor.

The milestone shows `approved` until the escrow partner confirms, then `released`.
Send an `Idempotency-Key` header: a retry with the same key returns the first answer.

while the BoQ is in review replaces it and clears every approval.

post.description:
Client, contractor or ops: approve the BoQ in review.

When all three have approved, the project becomes `active` and its milestones are created.
